author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
Contest Submission:

So I submitted this to the last contest but sadly the world was Griefed. I had to make this all over again but the past FFA contest was over before I finished! I got permission from Skyadia to submit this to the current contest.

Map Name: Ascension
Gamemode: FFA
Map Maker: Sethskye
Contributor: UltraBubbles618

Goal: Kill players while jumping on Platforms

Special: You spawn with Jump boost 5 and you can jump onto different platforms and ambush players by jumping over walls

Images: http://imgur.com/a/R1aO2
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/9fsd1dx0nyul4pu/Seth18.rar
YML: Soon

We didn't focus on Aesthetics but more Gameplay. The floor may look
plain but the game is fun when you play {Tested}
